basic_details.job_title: Bemetara District Panchayat Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 4 Accountant, Program Officer and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Bemetara District Panchayat has announced 4 contractual vacancies for Program Officer, Assistant Programmer and Accountant posts. Candidates can apply through the prescribed offline application process by sending their forms via registered post or speed post to the Chief Executive Officer, District Panchayat Bemetara, District Bemetara (C.G.), with the last date to apply being 5 November 2026. Qualifications vary by post, including MBA, MCA, BE, BTech, MSc and BCom with specific percentage requirements. The notified monthly pay is 39875 for Program Officer, 35165 for Assistant Programmer, and

age_limit.details: Program Officer: First-class degree in MBA / BE / BTech / MRTM (Master of Rural Technology and Management) / Mathematics / Physics postgraduate. Assistant Programmer: MCA (Computer Science / Information Technology) / MSc degree, or BE / BTech in Computer Science / Information Technology/Computer Science Engineering from a recognized university, or equivalent. Accountant: BCom with at least 55% marks, or passed intermediate in ICWAI / CA, or post-graduation in BCom with 55% marks. Age Limit: Minimum 21 years and maximum 35 years as of 01.01.2026, with an upper age relaxation up to 45 years for local resident unemployed youth of Chhattisgarh.

content_sections.heading: Bemetara District Panchayat Program Officer at a Glance

rows.details: MBA / MCA / BE / BTech / MSc / BCom

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Send completed application forms in a closed envelope via registered post or speed post only to the office of the Chief Executive Officer, District Panchayat Bemetara, District Bemetara (C.G.), Pin 491335 . The envelope must explicitly state the name of the applied post and category. Applications sent through any other medium will be rejected.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Program Officer: First-class degree in MBA / BE / BTech / MRTM (Master of Rural Technology and Management) / Mathematics / Physics postgraduate. Assistant Programmer: MCA (Computer Science / Information Technology) / MSc degree, or BE / BTech in Computer Science / Information Technology/Computer Science Engineering from a recognized university, or equivalent. Accountant: BCom with at least 55% marks, or passed intermediate in ICWAI / CA, or post-graduation in BCom with 55% marks. Age Limit: Minimum 21 years and maximum 35 years as of 01.01.2026, with an upper age relaxation up to 45 years for local resident unemployed youth of Chhattisgarh.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Self-attested copies of educational qualification mark sheets and certificates. Valid caste certificate issued by a competent authority for reserved categories. Chhattisgarh domicile certificate issued by a competent authority. Recent passport-size photograph affixed on the application form and self-attested. Experience certificates from government rural development schemes if applicable. Self-attested copies of all required supporting documents listed in the application format.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates are shortlisted on a merit basis derived from educational qualification weightage, computer practical tests, experience weightage, skill tests, and final document verification. For Assistant Programmer, 10 candidates are called per vacancy based on merit for skill tests. For other posts, shortlisting follows a merit ratio.

faq.question: Q1. Is this recruitment for a permanent job or on contract?
faq.answer: This is a contractual appointment initially valid until 28 February 2027, which may be extended annually based on satisfactory performance and project requirements.

faq.question: Q2. Who is eligible for age relaxation?
faq.answer: Local resident educated unemployed youth of Chhattisgarh receive an upper age relaxation of up to 5 years, making the maximum age limit 45 years.

faq.question: Q3. How are candidates shortlisted for the selection process?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted through a merit list based on academic qualification weightage, practical computer tests, and experience marks, followed by skill tests for applicable positions.

faq.question: Q4. Can applicants submit applications via email or online portals?
faq.answer: No, applications must be sent exclusively offline via registered post or speed post to the designated District Panchayat Bemetara address; online or email submissions are not accepted.

faq.question: Q5. What documents must be attached with the application?
faq.answer: Applicants must attach self-attested copies of educational mark sheets, category certificates, domicile certificates, recent passport-size photographs, and relevant work experience certificates.
